sources.title: Veridus | Largest Lobbying & Public Affairs Firm in Arizona
sources.notes: Official site positions Veridus as Arizona's largest and most experienced public affairs firm and lists Government Relations, Communications, Procurement, and Strategic Consulting.

sources.title: Services | Veridus.com
sources.notes: Official services page describes government relations, communications, procurement, and strategic consulting, including media relations, crisis communications, social media, reputation management, media training, stakeholder mapping, business development, and strategic intelligence.

sources.title: About | Veridus.com
